# Cully v0.11.3

Patch for data-API schema readiness.

- `cully-data serve` now requires schema version 6 (sessions/tasks and Team workspaces) before accepting traffic. A database stopped after older migrations no longer looks ready.
- Migration tests assert the required schema version stays aligned with Apply.

Upgrade: install the v0.11.3 CLI if needed, run the data image's `migrate` command, then redeploy MCP/data at the matching tag.
